MGI ALL STARS 2026 – POST-SASHING LEADERBOARD! 

Bangkok is glowing after that epic Welcome Ceremony & Sashing Night! ✨ Queens brought major heat in swimsuits and elegant sashes — the stage was pure fire! 👑

#Teamsuper Leaderboard Buzz:

1.🇨🇴 Colombia – Vanessa Pulgarin
2.🇻🇳 Vietnam – Nguyễn Hương Giang
3.🇵🇪 Peru – Suheyn Cipriani
4.🇵🇭 Philippines – Gazini Ganados
5.🇩🇴 Yamilex – Yamilex Hernández
6.🇵🇭 Philippines – Fuschia Anne Ravena

Honorable Mentions:
7.🇹🇭 Tharina Botes
8.🇬🇭 Faith Maria Porter 
9.🇲🇽 Francia Cortés
10.🇵🇭 Alexia Núñez

Colombia’s Vanessa Pulgarin is the consistent frontrunner across most lists.  Pinay queens are still SLAYING! Gazini holding strong in 4th with that fierce energy, and the iconic Fuschia Anne Ravena repping hard in 6th. Vietnam’s surge to No. 2 after snatching that fan-voted award last night is real — but our other PH girls are locked in and ready to climb! 🇵🇭💪

Who gave you goosebumps during the sashing? May 30 Grand Final is coming fast — vote, stream, and push your fave queens to the top! 👑
